title: A declined introduction clears and never comes back from old activity

objects.subject: Arjun <> Zara Hussain (Northlake)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Zara Hussain, who runs operations at Northlake and is looking at tools for her team. Zara, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Zara Hussain (Northlake)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Thank you, and nice to meet you. We've just signed with another vendor, so I'll pass for now. Best of luck with Nimbus Labs.

Zara Hussain
Head of Operations, Northlake

decision_states.subject: the introduction to Nimbus Labs
decision_states.quote: We've just signed with another vendor, so I'll pass for now.

objects.subject: Did you and Zara connect?
objects.body:
Hi Arjun, a week ago I introduced you to Zara Hussain at Northlake. Did the two of you get a chance to connect?

Introly

notes: Replay 02 m07: Zara declined the introduction the day it was made. Nothing to act on, and the connector's nudge a week later is old activity: it reopens nothing. The connector's history is kept.
